notes: DECISION: Shippo draws its capybara in three dark tints: #1B1D1D on goshippo.com's header (what the current files use, white in dark mode), #0E242D on its app icon (PNG only) and slate #2E434C in its docs SVGs. The slate is the only coloured vector and passes icon_check on both tiles (1.8:1 on #111), so it is one file for both themes. If Dhruv reads Shippo as monochrome, the current files (#1B1D1D / white) are fine as they are.
